papers.title: Homogenizing interfacial assembly via indole-mediated binary monolayers for perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) have emerged as efficient hole-transport layers for inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs), yet molecular self-aggregation during assembly limits interfacial homogeneity and device performance. Here we report an indole-carbazole co-adsorption strategy by incorporating N-indoleacetic acid (Nd) into (4-(3,6-diphenyl-9H-carbazol-9-yl)butyl)phosphonic acid (Ph-4PACz) to construct phase-homogeneous monolayers. Nd interacts with Ph-4PACz via synergistic π–π stacking and hydrogen bonding, resulting in a uniform alternating Ph-4PACz/Nd molecular arrangement. This co-adsorbed structure enables optimized interfacial energy alignment, enhances perovskite film uniformity, and suppresses trap-assisted non-radiative recombination. As a result, devices achieve an efficiency of 26.95% (certified 26.57%) on 0.0717 cm2 and 25.61% on 1 cm2, retaining 93.36% of their initial efficiency after 1500 h of maximum power point tracking under continuous illumination and 91.10% after 1200 h at 85 °C. The strategy is broadly applicable to carbazole-based SAMs and wide-bandgap PSCs, offering a general co-adsorption route toward efficient and stable devices.

**策略/方法**：提出吲哚-咔唑共吸附策略，将N-吲哚乙酸（Nd）引入Ph-4PACz分子中，通过协同π-π堆积与氢键作用构建交替排列的二元单层。

**机理/发现**：Nd与Ph-4PACz形成均匀交替分子排列，优化了界面能级对齐，提升了钙钛矿薄膜均匀性并抑制了陷阱辅助非辐射复合。

**学术价值**：该工作为通过分子共组装调控界面结构与光电性质提供了普适性策略，推动了高效稳定钙钛矿太阳能电池的界面工程发展。

**科学问题**：针对反钙钛矿氮化物带隙调控范围有限、难以覆盖可见光区的问题。

**策略/方法**：通过引入氢阴离子（H⁻）构建混合阴离子体系AE₅Pn₂(NH)₂，利用[N-H]⁻基团替代部分N³⁻，实现阴离子亚晶格与电子结构的协同调控。

**机理/发现**：[N-H]⁻的引入显著降低导带能量并增强阴离子-阳离子轨道杂化，使带隙在1.1–2.4 eV范围内连续可调，覆盖传统AE₃PnN体系难以实现的可见光低能区。

**性能/结果**：Sr₅Sb₂(NH)₂带隙低至1.1 eV，较对应氮化物（~2.0 eV）显著红移，拓展了光吸收边界。

**学术价值**：为混合阴离子策略调控宽带隙材料提供了新范式，推动了反钙钛矿体系在光电转换领域的材料设计。

**科学问题**：针对准量子点钙钛矿发光二极管（PeLEDs）中，传统反溶剂结晶工艺难以精确控制微区成核与生长，导致薄膜质量与器件性能不可重复的瓶颈。

**策略/方法**：提出“局域微溶剂场工程”，通过设计具有微米级亲/疏溶剂图案的基底，引导前驱体溶液在受限区域内定向去溶剂化与结晶。

**机理/发现**：该微溶剂场能精确调控溶剂的局部蒸发动力学与成核位点，实现了钙钛矿准量子点的受限生长与均匀分布，有效抑制了非辐射复合。

**性能/结果**：所制备的绿光PeLEDs外量子效率达28.5%，且在超过100个器件中展现出低于5%的性能波动，显著优于传统工艺。

**学术价值**：该工作为钙钛矿薄膜的可控、高通量制备提供了新范式，推动了PeLEDs向商业化应用的可靠性发展。

**科学问题**：针对空气环境中制备n-i-p钙钛矿太阳能电池时，钙钛矿薄膜缺陷密度高、非辐射复合严重导致效率显著低于惰性气氛制备器件的问题。

**策略/方法**：创新性地引入硫代乙酰脲（Thiacetazone）作为多功能添加剂，协同调控钙钛矿结晶动力学并钝化界面缺陷。

**机理/发现**：该添加剂中C=S和N-H基团能有效配位Pb²⁺空位，抑制碘空位形成；同时优化载流子传输层界面能级排列，减少界面复合。

**性能/结果**：全空气环境制备的器件获得26.1%的认证效率（稳态输出25.8%），是目前空气工艺器件的最高纪录，逼近手套箱工艺水平。

**学术价值**：该工作证明了通过分子设计实现高效空气工艺的可行性，为钙钛矿光伏的低成本、规模化制造提供了关键材料解决方案。

**策略/方法**：提出协同钝化策略，引入双功能分子（如含膦酸基与氨基的化合物），同步钝化体相晶界与钙钛矿/传输层界面。

**机理/发现**：该分子通过膦酸基与未配位Pb²⁺结合抑制缺陷态，同时氨基与有机间隔阳离子相互作用，抑制其不利聚集并优化相分布，提升载流子寿命与输运。

**性能/结果**：器件获得22.76%的认证效率（稳态输出22.1%），是目前报道的准二维PSC最高值之一，且未封装器件在最大功率点运行500小时后保持初始效率的92%。

**学术价值**：该工作为通过分子设计实现多缺陷位点协同钝化提供了明确范例，推动了准二维钙钛矿器件从效率提升向稳定性协同优化的研究范式发展。

**学术价值**：为PQD在光电子器件中的长期稳定性难题提供了普适性封装方案，推动了钙钛矿微显示技术的实用化进程。

papers.title: Controlled Cs⁺ incorporation through organocaesium salts in α-FA–Cs perovskite solar cells with a certified efficiency of 26.61%
papers.summary: Two-step fabrication method of formamidinium–caesium metal halide perovskites (FA1-xCsxPbI3) offers superior control over crystallization regulation and therefore is more suitable for solar cell manufacturing. However, forming the ideal α phase required for stable devices remains challenging due to limited Cs+ incorporation and unclear phase transition mechanism. Here we design caesium 4-(diphenylphosphino)benzoate to enable efficient Cs+ doping and to homogenize cation distribution, obtaining high-quality perovskite films with improved phase stability. As a result, the solar cells fabricated via the two-step process achieve an efficiency of 26.91% (certified 26.61%). The devices incorporating a thermally stable charge-transport layer retain 95% of their initial efficiency (23.76%) after continuous operation under 1-sun illumination at the maximum power point tracking and 85 °C (ISOS-L-2 protocol) for 1,500 hours. This study provides insights into the phase transition pathway and the corresponding transition-state structure of FA0.9Cs0.1PbI3 as well as the mechanism of Cs+-driven lattice stabilization in perovskites.

papers.title: Quasi-random oriented molecular contacts for inverted perovskite solar cells with improved efficiency
papers.summary: Self-assembled hole-selective molecules (SHMs) can enhance the efficiency and stability of inverted perovskite solar cells (PSCs). Their molecular structures and assembly arrangement at buried interfaces determine charge-transfer dynamics, perovskite crystallization and photovoltaic performance. We design self-assembled molecules featuring a laterally extended π-scaffold by attaching two flanking phenyl groups onto the 7H-dibenzo[c,g]carbazole. This design manipulates the molecular packing, resulting in a quasi-random oriented assembly on the substrate to accelerate the interfacial hole-transfer kinetics at both the substrate/SHM and SHM/perovskite interfaces. The solar cells achieve a stabilized power conversion efficiency of 27.1% (certified stabilized 26.67%) for a small-area PSC and 26.0% (certified stabilized 25.94%) for a 1-cm2 device. The small-area device retains 95% of its initial efficiency over 1,630 hours under 1-sun operation at 65 °C and 91% over 1,240 hours operation at 85 °C. These findings provide insights for designing improved self-assembled molecular contacts for inverted PSCs.
